_whyThePatternIsRepeated: The regex text is copied from limits.json on purpose, as the key. A pattern edited in limits.json without its probes updated fails the JavaScript test by name rather than quietly testing the old one.
_misses: Each miss is chosen to sit next to the boundary that decides it: a word character in front of `window`, an `s` after `Transaction`, `signInAnonymously` beside the Firebase names. A pattern loosened past its boundary trips its own misses first.
decoys: const stripes = drawStripes(ctx); const s = new Stripe(texture);
const ethereumColor = '#627eea'; // a planet named after the chain
_packages: `packages` holds script CDN URLs and the blocked package group each one serves, or null. Each CDN's own way of putting a prefix or a version around the npm name has a row, because that is where the two readers' hand-written path parsers could part. The nulls sit next to the boundary: a package that only starts like a blocked one, a blocked name on a host that is not a CDN, a scope with no package after it.
_bundles: `bundles` are whole games, small, each with the verdict both checkers must reach on it: `blocker` when anything refuses the upload, `warning` when something is put in front of a reviewer and nothing refuses, `pass` when gamePolicy has nothing to say. packages/preflight/tests/game-policy.test.ts runs each through platformPreflight and apps/pipeline/tests/test_game_policy.py through content.scan_content on contract 2027-03, so the jam scan and `opengame check` cannot disagree about one of them without a suite failing. Most are the review of 26 Oct 2026, by its fixture names, which found twenty shapes the preflight refused and the jam scan only mentioned.

review R33d: the budget is counted in UTF-16 units by both checkers. KNOWN MISS (review R33c, 27 Oct 2026, present before R33b): a ${} hole can follow one reading only, and after await a pattern holding ( is guessed to be division, so the } inside it closes the hole and [// opens a shader comment over the request. The whole class: the hole guess steps back over spaces and tabs only, so a comment, a no-break space or a line separator before a / makes it say division after any keyword or punctuation, and of, await or yield as plain names in a classic script can make it say pattern where JavaScript divides; one KNOWN MISS row per trigger sits beside this one. A fix needs both readings at the template level. Pinned at pass so a fix flips it on purpose.
